Starting balance — Intangible Asset — Edit

When transitioning to Manager.io or starting your accounting with existing intangible assets, it's important to set up accurate starting balances. This ensures your financial records reflect the true value of your assets from the beginning. This guide will walk you through the process of entering starting balances for your intangible assets.

Accessing the Starting Balance Form

  1. Navigate to the Intangible Assets tab on the left sidebar.
  2. Click on the intangible asset for which you want to set a starting balance.
  3. Click the Edit button to open the starting balance form.

Filling Out the Starting Balance Form

The form includes the following fields:

Intangible Asset

  • Description: Select the intangible asset you've previously created.
  • Instructions: Choose the specific intangible asset from the dropdown menu.

Starting Balance

  • Description: Enter the acquisition cost of the intangible asset.
  • Instructions: Input the original purchase price or cost of creation for the asset.
  • Example: If you acquired a patent for $15,000, enter 15000.

Starting Balance Accumulated Amortization

  • Description: Enter the accumulated amortization of the intangible asset up to the start date.
  • Instructions: Input the total amortization that has been recorded before using Manager.io.
  • Example: If the patent has been amortized by $3,000, enter 3000.

Saving the Starting Balance

After completing the fields:

  1. Review the information for accuracy.
  2. Click Update to save the starting balance for the intangible asset.

Verifying the Information

To confirm that the starting balance has been set correctly:

  1. Return to the Intangible Assets tab.
  2. Check the asset's details to ensure the acquisition cost and accumulated amortization are correct.
  3. Review your financial statements to see the impact of the starting balance.

Tips

  • Accuracy is Key: Ensure all amounts are accurate to maintain correct financial records.
  • Consult Professionals: If unsure about the amounts, consult with an accountant or financial advisor.
  • Consistent Entries: Use the same currency and accounting principles as your previous records for consistency.

By following these steps, you'll establish a solid foundation for your intangible assets in Manager.io, ensuring accurate accounting and reporting from the start.
